_note: Source map for the AI-crawling layer facts (src/lib/ai-layer-data.ts). Each output field names the repository file and the place in it the value is read from. tests/ai-layer-data.test.ts checks every /projects.json value against these files. Add a field here before adding it to the data.

projects.makersAndProducts: src/content/case-studies/<slug>.md frontmatter wallcoverings (exactly as /for-ai/ already prints them)
projects.venue: At a glance: first of Venue, Hotel, Building, House; otherwise the title
projects.scope: At a glance: first of Scope, Our work, Our package, Our role (nested items kept)
projects.dates: At a glance: first of Years on site, Works, Installed, Dates, When, Duration, Years
projects.partners: At a glance: first of In partnership with, Designer, Interior design, Scheme, Exhibitor, Event
projects.productsAsWritten: At a glance: first of Wallcoverings, Wallpaper, Product, Collection, Window film
projects.techniques, method: the case study's bold-lead method paragraphs (**Step.** text)
projects.preparation: the method paragraphs whose lead mentions preparation, strip-out or priming
projects.atAGlance: the whole At a glance list, label by label, Markdown syntax removed

site.since: src/content/team.json members[dorin-burcus].since (2012); the About page and about.json say the same
site.wastage: src/content/services.json pillars[surveying] sentence with 15–30% (the same sentence is in faq.json, the installation-cost guide, areas.json and trade.md)
site.award: src/data/facts.json award, only when present (added by PR #24); null until then
site.areas: src/data/facts.json place and coverage; src/content/areas.json items
site.enquiryRoutes: src/content/contact.json lede, direct, directNoPhone; src/data/facts.json email; src/lib/phone.ts (phone and WhatsApp exist only when SITE_PHONE is set at build)

notUsed./workspace/mrwallcover-site/pro-photos/P: labels photographs for projects not yet published with them; none of its jobs adds a fact to a published case study today
